title: Time-resolved transient absorption spectroscopy with quantum light
summary: We present a fully quantum theory of time-resolved transient absorption spectroscopy, providing a general framework for describing the linear response of a nonequilibrium target to quantum probe fields beyond the semiclassical approximation. We elucidate how quantum correlations between probe-field frequency modes couple to coherences in the target and derive a simple expression for computing the resulting spectroscopic signals.
